subject: english
question:
Choose the option that has an error in the sentence.

Recycling is now an essential measure and it is time for everyone in society to become more responsibility.

options.text: Recycling is now an essential measure
and it is time for everyone

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The main issue in the sentence lies in part **4**, where the word **"responsibility"** is incorrect in this context.
 
• The correct word to use is **"responsible"**, which is an adjective, as it is required to describe the subject.
 
• "Responsibility" is a noun and does not fit grammatically in the sentence structure.
 
• Thus, the error is found in part **4** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Recycling is now an essential measure and it is time for everyone in society to become more responsible."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "Recycling is now an essential measure"** – This part of the sentence is correct and does not contain any grammatical errors.
 
• **Option 2: "and it is time for everyone"** – This part of the sentence is also correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "in society to become"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct as well and does not need modification.
 
• **Option 4: "more responsibility"** – This part contains the error as explained above. The correct form should be "more responsible."
